title: Welded Breach Ox
text: Welded Breach Ox hauls a shrine-frame through the road and gores anything that slows the procession. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Its yoke is scripture written in load limits.

defeatReward.text: Welded Breach Ox is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
